P11.rationale: The page uses large typographic numbers ('6 von 6', '0') as data callouts bound to specific outcomes, but there are no actual charts, graphs, or before/after visual comparisons — only text-based statistics in the sidebar.

P13.rationale: The right-hand sidebar panel uses a dark textured/tonal background that creates atmospheric contrast against the white left column, providing intentional compositional depth rather than flat blankness throughout.
